## The problem

## What you propose

## What it would need to prove

A new extractor or capture needs a verified dependency closure against the store it reads, and
a test showing that an absent source reads as unavailable rather than as a measured zero.
Say how yours would establish both.

## Against the scope boundaries

`INTENT.md` puts cost modeling, budgets and alerts, scoreboard framing, a backend, and any
centralization of raw logs explicitly out of scope. If the proposal touches one of those,
say why it belongs anyway.
